{{Quote|Can you tell me where the Jawas went?''"<br />"''Sure, to their trading fort. Here are the directions.|A spacer and [[Peggin Dulin]]|<ref name="SWG:BB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Body Building|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Jawa mountain fortress''', also known as the '''Jawa Trading Outpost,''' was a settlement on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] inhabited by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] as a center of trade and commerce during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JMF" />

==History==
{{Quote|My master bids you good day, and asks what you are interested in buying.|[[C4-ZX]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:BB" />}}
This fortress on Tatooine was abandoned at an unknown point in history, before being inhabited by the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] some time before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. They then turned the fortress into a giant bazaar.<ref name="SWG:JMF2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Jawa Mountain Fortress|Tatooine}}</ref>

[[File:JawaMountainFortress.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jawas roaming the Fortress' marketplace]]

It was considered to be one of the few places the Jawas could call home. It was a permanent gathering place for Jawas who wanted to sell or trade goods in their bustling bazaar. [[Sandcrawler/Legends|Sandcrawlers]] could also be found parked at the fortress.<ref name="SWG:JMF" /> The fortress was the largest, permanent gathering place for the Jawa on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:JF">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Jawa Fortress|Tatooine}}</ref> Jawa tribes, settlers, thieves, and visitors from all over Tatooine met at the fortress to buy, sell, and bargain. The fortress also shelters desperate fugitives.<ref name="SWG:JMF2" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Jawa trader [[Ji'Ni Sil]] was approached by a spacer who was looking for a body casing from a [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] that once belonged to [[Peggin Dulin]] and was later salvaged by Jawas. The droid was actually wanted by both [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]]. Ji'Ni Sil's droid, [[C4-ZX]], informed the spacer that the droid casing was already sold to a [[robonium]] [[miner]]. Despite the miner was killed by [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]], the spacer finally managed to retrieve the casing.<ref name="SWG:BB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jawa Mountain Fortress appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts,<ref name="SWG:JMF" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
